articles.summary: BALA CYNWYD, Pa., Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Larimar Therapeutics, Inc. (Larimar) (Nasdaq: LRMR), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing treatments for complex rare diseases, today announced the appointment of John Harlow as President and Chief Operating Officer,
articles.title: Larimar Therapeutics Strengthens Executive Leadership with Appointment of John Harlow as President and Chief Operating Officer
